id: title:haacked:store related fields in the intent as primary keys

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the PostHog approvals workflow by ensuring compatibility between Django model instances and the JSON serialization used by the FeatureFlag serializer, potentially preventing failures when applying approved changes.
review.reason: Adds a helper function and imports to convert Django model instances and nested structures into wire-compatible forms. This is a bounded implementation and test, not a systemic capability.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the existing implementation without this conversion caused failures or compatibility issues, which is not demonstrated in the supplied hunk. No tests or error handling are visible in the provided context.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds UUID and Model imports, then a helper function to convert Django model instances and nested structures into wire-compatible forms (PKs or strings). P1.F1.H2 P1.F1.H3 P1.F2.H1 P1.F2.H2
observations.code_quote: return {key: _to_wire_form(value) for key, value in change.items()}
observations.posthog_connection: This could support the PostHog approvals workflow by ensuring that related fields stored in the approval intent are compatible with the JSON serialization and deserialization used by the FeatureFlag serializer, preventing failures when applying an approved change. This is a bounded implementation and test, not a systemic capability.
